risk_note: F1-08cc (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ③, D10-1733, D10-1772, D10-1890 / 1893 / 1895 / 1899 / 1900). Admin adjustments: approve (SMS step-up, one POST …/approve with body {}) and reject (no step-up, one POST …/reject with the trimmed reason) for system-prefilled pending adjustments. The approve dialog shows the available balance before and after and approval stays disabled until that balance is shown (in flight / read failure, with a re-read button; BR-FUND-24 ④, D10-1893). Every write goes through the F1-08ce result-unknown handling; after an enveloped 40901 / 5xx the page re-reads the adjustment and re-enables the decisions only if it is still pending (same key and body on replay; accepted by D10-1893); a later different decision that the server refuses with 20902 is shown and refreshed, never re-sent. Rebuilt on main after F1-08ce (rebase conflict, D10-1772 / D10-1890); money review r2 re-read the whole implementation. Frozen F1-08cb cases ENTRY#1 / #2 / #4 change only the later-entry lists (modify_existing with retitle_to, ledger #224; released by the orchestrator under D10-1899), ENTRY#3 is red_exempt, confirmed by a gate-record review. Rule tests by independent Claude contexts (ledger tester claude-independent), 3 rounds; spec-test 3 (third per approvals #96). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context). Written by hand.

reviews.note: money review by an independent Claude per ops/approvals.yaml #36 (claude-run.sh, fresh context; reviewer kept from round 1 per D10-1872): r1 pass; r2 after the rebuild on main re-read the whole implementation (D10-1890), pass with one S2 (approval possible before the balance was shown), fixed in this task (D10-1893); r3 reviewed only that fix, pass, 0 findings
